json.title: Database initialization failed

plain_lines: Storage error: Database error: connection refused
Failed to initialize the SQLite database. This could be due to permissions, disk space, or a corrupted database file.
• Database operation failed. Check workspace permissions and retry.
• Ensure the workspace directory is writable.
Run `ft why FT-2001` for more details.
